youtube.title: Five Little Ducks Go Splash 🦆 Count Down 5 to 0 for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Count down from 5 to 0 with Robo and five little ducks! The ducks splash into the pond, then one by one each little duck swims off to play hide and seek behind the reeds. Count the ducks, hold up your fingers, say peekaboo when a duck pops out, and watch the duck tracker empty. When the pond is empty, Mother Duck calls "Quack, quack, quack!" and all five ducks come swimming back. Then a fast countdown and a point-to-it game.

Your child learns: counting down 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0; how many are left when one goes away; showing a number on their fingers; zero means none.

Sing at home: hold up five fingers and fold one down for each little duck that swims off to play, then count them all back up when Mother Duck calls. The lyrics and the tune are original, written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
